caption: The point set behind shock_set_baddeley_delta on pressure, one panel per stored variant, on shared axes. Grey rings are the clean level's set of the same frame, the reference's, drawn under every panel. The lines are the field's line-out on this one-dimensional grid against the cell index, the clean level's in grey. Triangles on a panel's edge are points with an infinite coordinate. Only the first 4 of the 5 stored sets are drawn, in time order; every set is in data/error_maps.npz.
